<b>Pale Oil</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|tradable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Pale Oil can be brought to [[Pinmaster Plinney]] to upgrade [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Needle]].

The first Needle upgrade is completely free, while the following three require one Pale Oil each. The third upgrade also requires {{R|450}}, and the fourth requires {{R|680}}.

== How to Acquire ==
A total of three Pale Oil glands can be obtained, two of which are in [[The Citadel]] (available in Act 2) and one from the [[Flea Caravan]] in [[Putrified Ducts]] (available in Act 3).
